verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the integrated-board USB acceptance condition of enumeration in normal and forced-download modes.
First concrete failure: all three boards failed USB enumeration in both required modes and connector orientations while the control board succeeded.
Enumeration and flashing succeeded only after U3 was removed and bypassed, so this verifies a narrower USB path but not the target acceptance behavior requiring retained USBLC6 ESD protection.
